prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind them, softly lit by blue-hour twilight and warm lamps, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in blue-hour twilight with warm lamps glowing, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Thai man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth golden-tan skin, a confident smirk, cool ash-brown hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a gold round bell, an iron square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single silver necklace. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue ballet heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Russian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, copper-bronze smoky eyes with a golden highlight, pale smooth skin with a cool undertone, a gentle soft smile, sleek silver-grey hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver cube-shaped block, a gold barrel-shaped weight, a copper miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long gold chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop with a heavy rough tin a teardrop-shaped sinker hanging at its end, and a single gold ring. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black police cap with a silver badge, a thin black leather chest harness carrying a silver badge, steel handcuffs hanging from one hip string, and a minimal black leather T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the twilight and the warm lamp light in soft glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
